title: MY HOUSE IS A GIANT MACHINE?! ⚙️

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, don't let go [beat] because if this floor opens any wider we are both getting turned into human confetti!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I’m trying to hold on but the gravity in this room [beat] feels like it's flipping upside down right now!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Look at the walls, those aren't pipes, they are massive glass tubes [beat] filled with every single one of my missing video games!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Forget the games, Riku, look at that central furnace [beat] it’s glowing with the same weird energy as Grandpa’s old watch!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Why is there a giant brass engine [beat] hidden under the floorboards of a suburban house like some kind of steampunk nightmare?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I think this whole house isn't just a building [beat] it’s a massive machine and someone has been fueling it for decades!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: There’s a control panel over here with a nameplate that says [beat] Property of the Great Architect, do not touch or face deletion!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Riku, stay away from those levers because if you pull the wrong one [beat] the entire neighborhood might just vanish off the map!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The boys had finally found the heart of the mystery [beat] but the engine was just starting to warm up for its final mission.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: I found a logbook under the desk and the last entry is dated today [beat] and it’s signed with my Mom’s actual handwriting!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That means Aunt Lubna has been the one [beat] keeping this engine running while we were all just eating dinner upstairs!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait, do you hear that clicking sound coming from the ventilation shaft [beat] because I think we just tripped a silent alarm!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The doors are locking themselves and I can see [beat] a shadow moving behind the frosted glass of the main observation deck!
